result.description:
Resource Corner Pty Ltd has been built on the principles of integrity, partnership and innovation, traits that have allowed Resource Corner to establish itself as leader in its field since 2006. Resource Corner is global technology enterprise, focused on delivering excellence in complex digital environment, with relentless dedication in IT consulting and services. Resource Corner IT has been working with Banking and Telecom and Federal Department to help them achieve business agility, competitive edge, and growth. 
Job location:

Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153, you will be required to work on clients' office (on multiple locations possible), depending on the engagement, whilst remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner

Type of position:  permanent ongoing 

Minimum Qualification: Any bachelor’s degree in major computing or equalent

Experience Range:
5 to 15 years

Job Description – Developer / Programmer 

The overview of this role involves interpreting the specifications, technical designs and flow charts., It also mainly involves building, maintaining and modifying the code for software applications, constructs technical specifications from a business functional model, and tests and writes technical documentation. You will also be researching, consulting, analyzing and evaluating system program needs. 
You will also be involved in identifying technology limitations and deficiencies in existing systems and associated processes, procedures and methods. Furthermore, you will be required to perform testing, debugging, diagnosing and correcting errors and faults in an applications programming language within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure programs and applications perform to specification. 

In addition, you will be writing and maintaining program code to meet system requirements, system designs and technical specifications in accordance with quality accredited standards. 

Other Developer Programmer related responsibilities as required
To be considered for this role, you will have as per the below Job Description

Detailed Job description: -

Primary or Mandatory skills: -
Minimum 5 years of real time experience in below technologies:
•	Develop, build, review and test frontend and backend software solutions
•	Work with other developers and business to propose high quality system solutions to meet business goals
•	Provides support including analysis, development, testing and code review
•	Troubleshoot application issues and provide feedback for enhancement
•	Designing, coding, and implementing solutions using Salesforce applications
•	Involved in Database design of all the analytical models from the scratch.
•	Created DB procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, views for the execution of the analytical models
•	Complete Analytical model structure development in the Database.
•	Involved in the UI development on the web pages and template design.
•	Involved in the requirements gathering process
•	Creation of table structures for customer and merchant transactions.
•	UNIX scripts for automation of daily batch load process.
•	Analysis of business and technical requirements, prototyping.
•	Database design for system configuration.
•	Performance tuning of oracle database and user applications.

Skillset Required
· Must have hands on to work on tools like Python, SQL,  Machine Learning, DOCKER, Cloud Computing AWS AZURE, Core java, J2EE, Spring Boot / Spring Micro-service, PL/SQL. Spring Tool Suite, AWS cloud server, Oracle ADF, Java.
· Agile ways of working
. Strong Analytical and problem-solving skills

Good to have skills: -
Good to have Jenkins and Terraforms knowledge along with support tools (Docker, Git, Bash, AWS CLI)

Roles and Responsibilities
Associate must be capable of handling the business requirements of the customer and working with internal teams in getting the requirements fulfilled may it new or enhancement on existing.
Should be able to identify risks early on and plan how to manage them to maximizing the chances of delivery project success.
Salary: $100k to $150k plus super

Next steps 

If you feel this opportunity suits you, or RESOURCE CORNER IT is the type of organization you would like to join, we want to have a conversation with you! Please apply directly with us.

For a complete list of open opportunities with RESOURCE CORNER IT, visit http://www.resourcecornerit.com
This is an exciting opportunity to join in an innovative team in Norwest, NSW 2153 this is a newly created Fulltime position - Monday to Friday from 8.30am to 4.30pm in a friendly, professional working environment which focuses on customer solution strategy. 

If you have a passion for leveraging the best from cutting-edge technologies; have an eye for elegance, flexibility and efficiency in design; and are passionate about technology we want to hear from you.

RESOURCE CORNER IT is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities. Successful candidates will be required to undergo a background check.

*As our industry falls under the Government Covid19 Vaccine Mandate and will require proof of vaccinations.

result.description:
Testing & Diagnostics Engineer  
 
  Excellent entry-level exposure for a graduate with an industry giant  
  Contract / Temp (3 Months - Full-Time or Part-Time options available)  
 Great, rewarding opportunity for mature-age job seekers/ retirees 
 
  About the Company  
  Our client is an international market leader and innovator in connected technologies and advanced electronics. Operating on the cutting edge of sustainable tech, they develop intelligent systems that transform commercial, industrial, and residential spaces globally. They are currently seeking a technically sharp Engineer to join their specialized testing facility in Moorebank on an initial 3-month contract, with flexible full-time or part-time hours to suit the right candidate.  
  Role Purpose  
  In this hands-on lab role, you will test, diagnose, and analyze advanced electronic equipment and connected hardware to ensure compliance with strict quality and safety standards. This is an exceptional opportunity to gain exposure to state-of-the-art testing machinery, digital drivers, and smart automated networks.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Test and diagnose advanced electrical components and smart system hardware using oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and specialized lab equipment.  
  Evaluate products against local safety regulations and radio disturbance standards (such as AS/NZS or equivalent international frameworks).  
  Troubleshoot automated network interfaces and digital driver software (utilizing protocols like DALI, Zigbee, or Bluetooth Low Energy).  
  Assist in managing, calibrating, and maintaining laboratory equipment to ensure complete data integrity.  
  Document test results and compile clear technical findings for engineering teams.  
 
  Skills & Experience Required  
 
  A Bachelor's Degree in  Electrical Engineering or Electrical Trade Certification  is mandatory  
 Experience in electrical testing (preferably within a NATA-accredited environment) 
 Knowledge of measurement uncertainties, electrical theory and testing techniques. 
 Ability to comprehend lighting product testing standards, such as AS/NZS, IEC, and other relevant regulations. 
 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and generate actionable insights. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear and comprehensive technical reports. 
 Competency in using MS Office applications especially Excel. 
 Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 
 Ability to work both independently and as part of a close-knit team in a fast-paced environment. 
 Preferably minimum of 2 years in an electrical industry or equivalent practical experience in a similar testing environment
